dcc-mcp 0.19.98

- Updated version metadata to 0.19.98.

**Major update: Improved routing, expanded product support, and stricter UI automation boundaries.**

- Expanded to cover 35 released creative products and 3 application UI routes, with detailed alias and routing references in PRODUCTS.json.
- Adds and documents a local application path cache (see LOCAL_APP_PATH_CACHE.md); agents now prompt and confirm before launching from a cached executable path.
- Explicitly separates DCC application UI control (DCC-CUA / ui-control) from generic Computer Use; DCC-CUA route is now a hard provider boundary with enforced attestation and fresh-state requirements.
- Removed skill-card.md; updated SKILL.md for concise routing logic and clearer boundaries between automation systems.
- Updated search hints and compatibility metadata to reflect extended product coverage and stricter invocation practices.
